qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Specialty Lloyd's syndicate and reinsurance underwriting subject to global wholesale broker mediation (Marsh, Aon, WTW) and severe pricing cycles. Lacks sustainable pricing power across the full cycle; multi-cycle ROE fell to sub-hurdle levels (8.1% in 2021, 10.1% in 2022) due to high catastrophe losses and litigation exposure (Covid-19 BI claims).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Pricing & Proof of Moat). Specialty Lloyd's and retail insurer exposed to severe catastrophe volatility, wholesale broker gatekeepers, and cyclical soft/hard pricing swings. Multi-cycle ROE/ROIC falls well below the 12% hurdle during normal and soft-market periods (8.1% in 2021, 10.1% in 2022).
qualitative.evidence: Hiscox operates across Retail, London Market, and Re & ILS. Performance is heavily tied to the global commercial and reinsurance pricing cycle. Pre-tax profit plunged during the Covid-19 business interruption disputes where Hiscox faced major UK FCA court action. Return on equity in 2021 (8.1%) and 2022 (10.1%) failed the 12% cost-of-capital hurdle before rebounding during the 2023-2025 hard reinsurance market. Lacks structural pricing power independent of industry capacity cycles.
